name: CodeGraphContext
description: Indexes every repo under the workspace into a local code graph (functions, classes, imports, call chains) and exposes it to any agent as MCP tools, plus a graph visualizer UI. Installs its own isolated `cgc` CLI, keeps the graph fresh via a low-priority periodic reconciler (never a real-time file watcher), and runs the visualizer as a managed background service.

resource_estimate.memory: ~150 MB idle; can spike into the GBs during the one-time initial index of a large workspace

skills.description: What CodeGraphContext indexes, how its MCP tools work and how the workspace's MCP Gateway discovers them, how to trigger a reindex, and how the visualizer/reconciler services behave.

auto_start.description: Start the visualizer service automatically when the workspace starts.

index_root.description: Root directory indexed by CodeGraphContext. Dotfiles/dot-directories (.git, .venv, .nvm, .cache, ...) are always skipped.

visualizer_port.description: Port the graph visualizer web UI binds to on 127.0.0.1 (proxied into the app window, never exposed directly).

reconcile_interval_s.description: How often (seconds) the low-priority reconciler runs `cgc update` to catch up on file changes. Default 15 min keeps the graph well within a 1h staleness bound without a real-time file watcher.

initial_index_parallel_workers.description: Worker count for the one-time initial full index. Lowered from an earlier default of 4 after a live OOM kill indexing a large multi-repo workspace — raise it only if you know the workspace being indexed is small.

reconcile_parallel_workers.description: Worker count for the recurring low-priority reconciler tick (kept low on purpose — CPU-gentle, not real-time).

index_source.description: Store full source code text in the graph database. Off by default — found live: indexing a large multi-repo workspace with this on ran the container out of memory (an OOM kill, not an app error). Not needed for the MCP tools this app exposes (find_code, analyze_code_relationships, ...), which work off the graph structure, not stored source text.

apps.reason: CodeGraphContext contributes an mcp.json definition that is discovered and merged by the MCP Gateway app (same pattern as aw-app-mcp-tools).
